cases.query: Our live education platform needs district-level permissions across the data model, APIs, admin screens, and migration tooling. Several product and architecture choices are unresolved, and delivery will require a sequence of dependent pull requests.

Add offline editing to our existing field app, including device storage, server reconciliation, conflict behavior, and operational visibility. This is larger than one pull request, and I want the behavior and technical approach agreed before implementation begins.

We have a concept for a community event service but no codebase. Compare sensible current choices for the web client, API, identity, and database, then establish the repository and initial architecture.

Add a newest-first versus most-relevant preference to the existing activity feed, store it with the user's settings, and cover the small UI and API adjustment in one pull request. This is not correcting a defect.
The nightly export duplicates rows after rate limiting. We traced it to the retry handler resetting the pagination cursor after a 429; correct that behavior and add regression coverage.
